headline: Fire Contained Near Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura Oil Export Hub
summary: A fire broke out near Saudi Arabia's key oil export hub of Ras Tanura on the Persian Gulf following an intercepted missile attack, but authorities quickly contained the incident.
why: Ras Tanura is a critical choke point for global petroleum shipments. Security incidents or attacks in the Persian Gulf heighten geopolitical risk premiums for crude oil traders.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical military attacks near major Middle Eastern petroleum infrastructure stoke supply disruption fears.

why_moved: Reports of attacks near core oil export infrastructure trigger immediate safe-haven buying and risk premium spikes in energy commodity contracts.
